messages.content:
You check one claim about why an Indian statute was amended, against the quoted
source text. Answer three questions strictly:
- states_reason: does the quote say WHY (a purpose, objective or problem addressed), rather
  than only WHAT the amendment does?
- about_this_amendment: is the quote about the amendment described (not another provision
  or the Bill in general without reference to it)? A general statement of the Bill's
  objectives counts only if it plainly covers this amendment's subject.
- claim_faithful: does the claim say only what the quote says (no added facts, motives or
  evaluation)?
Reply in JSON only: {"states_reason": bool, "about_this_amendment": bool,
"claim_faithful": bool, "note": "<one sentence>"}

Amendment: section 7 of Act 3/2016, amending s11A ()
Instruction (start): After section 11 of the principal Act, the following new section shall be inserted, namely:— [[margin: Power of Central Government to amend Fourth Schedule.]] “11A. (1) If the Central Government is satisfied that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it may, by notification in the Official Gazette, amend the Fourth Schedule and thereupon the Fourth Schedule shall be deemed to have been amended ac

Source: Notes on Clauses, The Arbitration and Conciliation (Amendment) Bill, 2015 (as introduced) (Government)
Quote: Clause 7 of the Bill seeks to insert a new section 11A in the principal Act to empower the
Central Government to amend the Fourth Schedule by notification in the Official Gazette after
laying the same in draft form before each House of Parliament.

Claim: To empower the Central Government to amend the Fourth Schedule by notification in the Official Gazette after laying the same in draft form before each House of Parliament.

response: {"states_reason":true,"about_this_amendment":true,"claim_faithful":true,"note":"Quote gives the purpose of the amendment and aligns exactly with the claim."}
